question: **Select the correctly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Convert**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options the correctly spelt word is '**Convert**'.
 
• It means 'to change from one form, system or use to another'. (एक रूप, पद्घति या उपयोग-प्रकार से दूसरे में परिवर्तन करना, बदलना)
 
 
• *Example: a sofa that **converts** into a double bed...*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the correct spelling along with meaning of other given options-

__
 
• consent- permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.
 
• Connect- bring together or into contact so that a real or notional link is established.
 
• Convict- declare (someone) to be guilty of a criminal offence by the verdict of a jury or the decision of a judge in a court of law.

**Correct Answer:__** *Convert.*
